Level 13 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: Ability to use a Holy Symbol or Druidic Focus as a Spellcasting Focus
Space: Cramped
Hirelings: 1
Order: Harvest

A vault holding sacred objects.

Reliquary Charm. After you spend a Long Rest in your Bastion, you gain a magical Charm that lasts for 7 days or until you use it, letting you cast Greater Restoration once without expending a spell slot or using Material components. You can't gain this Charm again while you still have it.

Harvest: Talisman. The hireling prepares a talisman for you in 7 days, at no cost: a Tiny nonmagical object of religious significance, such as an amulet, a rune-carved box, or a statuette. You can use it in place of a spell's Material components costing 1,000 GP or less; if the spell consumes its components, the talisman isn't consumed. Once used, it can't be used again until you return it to your Reliquary and issue another Harvest order to prepare it.
